Bitdefender is a cybersecurity leader delivering best-in-class threat prevention, detection, and response solutions worldwide. Guardian over millions of consumer, enterprise, and government environments, Bitdefender is one of the industry’s most trusted experts for eliminating threats, protecting privacy, digital identity and data, and enabling cyber resilience. With deep investments in research and development, Bitdefender Labs discovers hundreds of new threats each minute and validates billions of threat queries daily. The company has pioneered breakthrough innovations in antimalware, IoT security, behavioral analytics, and artificial intelligence and its technology is licensed by more than 180 of the world’s most recognized technology brands. Founded in 2001, Bitdefender has customers in 170+ countries with offices around the world. For more information, visit https://www.bitdefender.com
We are looking for a Data Analyst who is passionate about turning data into actionable insights and building data-driven solutions that support business decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of data, technology, and business, requiring strong analytical capabilities, technical expertise, and the ability to partner effectively with stakeholders across the organization.
As a Data Analyst, you will work closely with both technical and business teams to understand their needs, translate requirements into scalable analytical solutions, and help drive better decisions through data products, reporting, and analytics
 Key Responsibilities
Key role in creating and maintaining reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions using Power BI that support business decisions
Partner with stakeholders across multiple business functions to understand challenges, opportunities, and data needs
Work closely with analysts from other departments on defining and implementing solutions for new reporting needs, offer support regarding data inquiries
Leverage analytical applications to translate data into stories and explain the meaningful conclusions of the analysis in written verbal and visual form
Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across reporting and analytical solutions
Proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, data accessibility, and decision-making through analytics
 Qualifications & Skills
3-5 years of relevant analytical experience in a Data Analyst/Reporting Analyst/Business Intelligence Developer position
Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, aggregations, CTEs, and performance optimization
Previous experience working with data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau or Qlik)
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
Excellent business acumen and the ability to connect data insights to business outcomes
Ability to communicate complex findings in a clear and actionable manner
 Nice-to-have
Experience with data modeling concepts and dimensional models
Knowledge of ETL/ELT processes and data warehousing principles
 Why Bitdefender?
 At Bitdefender, you’ll be part of a mission-driven company that is shaping the future of cybersecurity. We foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.
You’ll have the opportunity to work with highly skilled professionals, contribute to impactful global projects, and grow your career in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.
